C x.di-interface-registration EX ARC-021,ARC-007 DEFAULT ;; Register Application services, repositories and external adapters at architectural boundaries interface-to-implementation; concrete registration only for implementation-only helpers without a separate contract. ;; = ;; Implementation-only helpers. ;; Registration-shape rule not entailed by ARC-021..ARC-023.
C gov012.explicit-registration OL GOV-012,GOV-013 PREFER ;; Prefer explicit registration in small/medium apps; add convention scanning, keyed services, factories or decorators only when they solve an actual composition problem. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc023.layer-registration OL ARC-023 DEFAULT ;; Application exposes its own registration method, Infrastructure registers technical implementations, and the API composes them. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.di-technique-conditions EX GOV-012 DEFAULT ;; Use keyed services only when implementations are selected by a known key; decorators when the same cross-cutting behaviour wraps an abstraction; assembly scanning only for genuinely repetitive registration and over the assembly that owns the services. ;; = ;; none ;; Conditional DI technique selection (EXC-005 classifies decorators/scanning as optional technique).
C dep001.no-scrutor-for-one OL DEP-001,GOV-013 MUST_NOT ;; Do not add Scrutor solely for one decoration when normal composition is simpler (adding it goes through add-dependency). ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc022.scope-per-operation OL ARC-022,ARC-001 MUST ;; When a singleton/hosted service genuinely needs scoped work create a scope per operation and resolve a scoped orchestration service, not Infrastructure internals. ;; = ;; none ;;
